name: Koi Tenshi
source:
"Angel festival" is held at Christmas time in a certain Catholic school ... suddenly girl students become lascivious at the school festival and forget about that afterwards. Hero gets to the be in the mids of these events.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某天主教学校在圣诞节期间举办“天使节”……突然间，女学生们在学园祭期间变得淫荡起来，然后就忘记了这一点。英雄在这些事件中脱颖而出。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
